candidate_reports.remark: Media reported nickel-size hail near Pottsboro at 5:35pm.
Facebook photo showed a tree down in Pottsboro.
A microburst caused roof and wall damage to metal frame buildings at Cumby High School. There was also minor sheet metal roofing damage at a nearby home. Time estimated.
VFD reports multiple large trees downed and blocking several county and FM roads in and around the town of Cumby.
A local resident reported a microburst caused wind damage around the intersection of Pedernales Dr at Lampasas Drive. A barn was destroyed with debris blown up to 400 yards away. A few trees were als
Ham radio reports moderate wind damage including damage to fencing_ house siding_ and small tree branches near PR 4732 NE of Rhome.
Emergency management reported trees down in the roadway near CR-4717 and CR-4730. Gutters and shingles torn from a roof. A small shed was blown from its original location and destroyed.
EM reported several fences collapsed in the Sendera Ranch subdivision.
Trained spotter reported dime size hail with sporadic quarters near the intersection of Park Vista Blvd and Keller Haslet Rd in far northern Tarrant County.
Emergency management reported 1 to 1.5 inch hail near Alliance in the Golden Triangle area.
Social media report of a partial roof collapse of a commercial business and powerlines over the road at Rufe Snow Dr and Chapman Rd in Watauga.
NWS Employee reports 8 inch diameter tree limbs snapped near I30 and Eastchase Pkwy.
